A FEW HELPFUL ANSWERS

Clarity before
your next step.

Ask Mike a question ↗
Do the illustrations guarantee funding?+

No. Provider review determines approval, amount, pricing, and timing. Any amounts or timelines shown in supplied artwork are promotional examples, not an offer to your business.

Are all financing products the same?+

No. Product structures, total costs, payment schedules, guarantees, and other obligations can differ. Review the actual agreement and ask the provider to explain the terms.

Where should bank statements and applications go?+

Use the provider’s application and secure document process. This hub does not collect banking information or submit applications.
